triples.tail_surface: initial leakage like drops or a small trickle during first start-up
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 初次启动时的滴漏或细流泄漏
triples.evidence_text: A mechanical seal might have some initial leakage like drops or a small trickle during first start-up as it has not yet fully settled and become tight.

triples.head_surface: initial leakage like drops or a small trickle during first start-up
triples.head_canonical_zh: 初次启动时的滴漏或细流泄漏
triples.tail_surface: Observe the mechanical seal to see if leakage stops
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 观察机械密封以确认泄漏是否停止
triples.evidence_text: Observe the mechanical seal to see if leakage stops, if not it could be enough to dismantle the mechanical seal and clean it properly to stop the leakage.

triples.head_surface: initial leakage like drops or a small trickle during first start-up
triples.head_canonical_zh: 初次启动时的滴漏或细流泄漏
triples.tail_surface: dismantle the mechanical seal and clean it properly
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆卸并正确清洁机械密封
triples.evidence_text: if not it could be enough to dismantle the mechanical seal and clean it properly to stop the leakage.
hence a mechanical seal failure is often the first indication of problems.

triples.tail_surface: Inspect the pumps regularly for initial leakage
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 定期检查泵的初期泄漏
triples.evidence_text: Inspect the pumps regularly for initial leakage.

triples.tail_surface: replace seal as quickly as possible
triples.evidence_text: If leakage is observed it is important to take action to replace seal as quickly as possible.

triples.head_surface: shaft seal leak drain hole in the rear cover (or in bearing cover / bracket on some pump designs)
triples.head_canonical_zh: 后盖（或某些泵设计中的轴承盖/支架）上的轴封泄漏排水孔
triples.tail_surface: Check regularly that the shaft seal leak drain hole ... is not clogged up
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 定期检查轴封泄漏排水孔是否堵塞
triples.evidence_text: Check regularly that the shaft seal leak drain hole in the rear cover (or in bearing cover / bracket on some pump designs) is not clogged up.
A clogged shaft seal leak hole can lead to premature bearing failure due to water rising up into the pump ball bearings when the shaft seal is worn out and/or damaged.

triples.head_surface: water rising up into the pump ball bearings
triples.evidence_text: premature bearing failure due to water rising up into the pump ball bearings when the shaft seal is worn out and/or damaged

triples.head_surface: shaft seal is worn out and/or damaged
triples.tail_surface: water rising up into the pump ball bearings
triples.evidence_text: water rising up into the pump ball bearings when the shaft seal is worn out and/or damaged
